task: Evaluation of empty room shell + required furniture inventory -> FastFill predicts unknown sizes/layout -> RoomGenBench mesh

upstream.paper_status: No paper link found in official README/tree; explicit web searches for RoomGenBench/paper/arxiv returned no results. This is not proof no paper exists; evidence here is official public code, not a claimed peer-reviewed publication.

core_conclusion: RoomGenBench is a downstream asset/mesh benchmark conditioned on provided layouts. It does not by itself evaluate FastFill empty-shell layout or unknown-size prediction. The correct evaluation requires an upstream layout layer, a downstream controlled asset layer and all-request end-to-end mesh-layout checks.

official_inputs.known_layout_owner: SAGE-10k annotations; shared assembler positions assets. Asset methods do not predict room arrangement.
official_inputs.asset_key: slug(type)[:24] + sha1(description)[:8]; metric dimensions/place of first instance enter unique-asset registry, instance geometry remains on scene records.

coordinate_contract.FastFill: meters, right-handed Z-up, bottom-center, full local [sx,sy,sz], local +X front, yaw rad CCW from world +X
coordinate_contract.SceneSpec_SAGE: meters, Z-up, bottom-center, width local X / length local Y; front +Y; Euler XYZ degrees, Rz@Ry@Rx
coordinate_contract.conversion: Scene width=FastFill sy; length=sx; height=sz; z rotation=degrees(wrap(yaw-pi/2)); position unchanged
coordinate_contract.generated_asset_GLB: glTF Y-up, front +Z, arbitrary native scale/offset
coordinate_contract.upstream_fit: GLTF_TO_SAGE maps (x,y,z)->(-x,z,y), yaw snap/aspect quarter turn, optional 90deg tip, anisotropic fit to target box, bottom-center to origin, then placement
coordinate_contract.local_fixtures: 0/90/-90/45deg asymmetric box corner Hausdorff error <=9.94e-16m, front-axis error <=1.58e-16. This verifies transforms, not semantic-front prediction.

official_metrics.implementation: Qwen2.5-VL-7B normalized Yes/No logits; average over views
official_metrics.missing: Placeholder box is rendered/scored; not dropped
official_metrics.does_not_measure: Layout position quality, navigability, physical stability or calibrated probability of correctness

official_metrics.implementation: L2-normalized view/text embeddings; similarity x100 and correct-description rank after averaging image views
official_metrics.missing: Placeholder is included in all-asset aggregate
official_metrics.does_not_measure: Unknown size accuracy or room-level spatial reasoning

official_metrics.implementation: Status ok OR fallback counts as generated
official_metrics.does_not_measure: Strict genuine-method success; fallback must also be reported separately

official_metrics.unit: available generated object-supporter pair in the fixed reference layout
official_metrics.implementation: 25 downward rays from central 60% bbox grid; success iff hit_rate>=0.5 and absolute median gap<=0.02m
official_metrics.missing: Pair omitted if either side has no loaded mesh; report n, not just percent
official_metrics.does_not_measure: All-ray contact, floor/wall mounting, center-of-mass stability, full-body collision or dynamic physics

official_metrics.implementation: Qwen Yes/No score for furnished room type and building style; missing image -> nan, aggregate nanmean
official_metrics.does_not_measure: Direct numeric geometric validity or unseen room generalization

official_metrics.unit: unique asset, fitted in same reference bbox
official_metrics.implementation: View embedding similarity; surface samples 10000 each, normalized nearest-neighbor distances, F-score at 2%/5% diagonal
official_metrics.missing: Placeholder included; reference SAGE meshes required locally
official_metrics.does_not_measure: A unique correct asset shape; SAGE assets were themselves generated and the reference favors related appearance

not_measured_by_official_benchmark: Empty-shell room-layout prediction correctness/unknown size prediction
Counterfactual constraint following or fixed-world edits
Navigation/accessibility/door clearance as an explicit programmatic benchmark metric
Arbitrary room topology, windows or generalization beyond fixed five rooms
Full mesh collision-free room validity, COM stability, wall mounting or rigid-body simulation
Total inference/generation/assembly latency or task-level reliability of FastFill

current_fastfill_metrics.bbox_geometry: evaluate.py reports symmetry-aware size/yaw/position reference errors, upright BEV IoU, collapse, collision/containment and strict/unknown checks
current_fastfill_metrics.usability_proxies: ops/layout_quality.py NAV/ACC/COL/OPC/SG/REL are bbox/rule/relationship proxies; not mesh physics or the exact official SceneEval implementation
current_fastfill_metrics.VLM_status: ops/vlm_judge.py builds deterministic bbox panels/anchors and layout_boxes handoffs; it does not call a VLM or score generated meshes
current_fastfill_metrics.dynamic_assembly: roomgenbench.py reads arbitrary exported handoffs and generated GLB/sidecars; records native/fitted extents and failures but does not run official score scripts

gaps.evidence: All 313 official objects receive source place_id as support_parent, while each of five source doors is omitted and re-exported door count is zero.
gaps.impact: Current benchmark_request is an oracle-support rectangular-input ablation, not strict empty shell + required inventory with unknown placement/size. It removes door-clearance difficulty.
gaps.recommendation: Build canonical conditions from the observed empty shell (actual polygon, floor/height, wall-relative openings, fixed geometry only when given) plus ID/category/description requests. Do not copy target size/position/yaw/support unless user-supplied. Keep GT-support and known-size protocols explicitly named ablations.

gaps.evidence: Official scorers load bench/inputs/assets.jsonl and fixed SCENES; local adapter only exports mesh + receipt and does not invoke these scorers.
gaps.impact: Running unmodified official scripts does not score arbitrary FastFill handoffs and may score old reference layouts/assets instead.
gaps.recommendation: Add a derivative evaluation runner outside upstream bench that consumes explicit handoff/assembly/asset-registry paths and provenance, reusing pure scoring helpers. Preserve the official benchmark unchanged.

gaps.evidence: Shared fitter rotates/snaps/tips and anisotropically forces asset extents to target bbox.
gaps.impact: Post-fit bbox agreement is a transport sanity check, not evidence that FastFill size predictions are accurate or native asset proportions fit naturally.
gaps.recommendation: Score predicted dimensions before fitting against trustworthy labels and physical/category priors; separately report scale anisotropy=max(scale)/min(scale), fit distortion, yaw-snap and tip counts. Fix generation method/seeds/cache across layout arms.

gaps.evidence: layout_boxes receipt: assembly_complete=true, generated_mesh_success=false. A synthetic cuboid with ok sidecar: generated_mesh_success=true while validator=not_attempted, support=not_checked, physics=not_attempted.
gaps.impact: GLB existence, completed assembly and generated_mesh_success cannot be reported as geometrically valid furnished-room success.
gaps.recommendation: Report phase-specific completion and strict all-request mesh-layout success, plus collision/containment/opening/support checks. Keep physics unknown unless actually simulated; a WorldEdge host is outside this downstream output task.

gaps.evidence: Adding one window to canonical metadata produces identical shell vertices/faces. An L-shaped 12m2 input floor becomes a 4.2x4.2 rectangular slab (17.64m2 including outward margin). Official five rooms have no windows and rectangular shells, so their tests do not expose this.
gaps.impact: General empty-shell geometry may be visually/physically wrong even when metadata retains a polygon and windows.
gaps.recommendation: Render/verify true polygon floor geometry; implement window cutouts or mark them explicitly unsupported. Retain the known shell as immutable evaluation input and compare geometry, not metadata only.

gaps.evidence: Official five room JSONs include 12 instances with >1deg X/Y tilt. FastFill ground_truth_layout drops X/Y rotations.
gaps.impact: Reference roundtrip and mesh comparison need an upright-projection label; tilted instances cannot be claimed as exact full-6DoF recovery.
gaps.recommendation: Report upright subset separately; evaluate the existing model on its supported yaw-only task and preserve tilt in downstream fixtures if future models support it.

gaps.evidence: Predicted parent can guide export, but core runtime/validator use request support declarations and leave undeclared support unknown; mixed partial graphs can form cycles on merge.
gaps.recommendation: Use one merged candidate support graph with declared/predicted/inferred provenance, validate cycles after merging, and check actual mesh contact separately rather than treating the predicted label as proof.

gaps.evidence: Local support accuracy skips no-layout requests; condensed table shows no-hard-violation clean rate without the hard-unknown rate. Official support metric also has a conditional generated-pair denominator.
gaps.recommendation: Report all-request success, conditional quality, output coverage and eligible pair coverage together; do not equate conditional support percentages across methods with different generation coverage.

minimal_acceptance_plan.name: Freeze the intended input contract
checks: Canonical room shell + required ID/category/description list; hide target bbox/pose and GT support unless explicitly provided by the user.
Preserve room polygon, floor elevation, height, all doors/windows and any truly fixed geometry.
Pin input/model/tokenizer/code/upstream commit/seed/decode/asset-generation identities; paired arms use identical admitted input rows and budgets.
Separate strict unknown-size layout task, oracle-support ablation, known-size ablation and GT-layout downstream upper bound.
minimal_acceptance_plan.pass: No target geometry/support leakage; exact preservation of all observed shell facts.

minimal_acceptance_plan.name: CPU interface fixtures before large model runs
checks: Asymmetric 2x1x0.8m boxes at yaw 0/90/-90/45deg, nonzero origin/floor and known front marker; compare 8 world corners and front axes.
L-shaped shell, multiple doors on one wall, window sill/cutout, wall-mounted furniture and table-lamp/fixed-support relations.
Identical type+description with repeated instances/different target dimensions; one asset key, distinct instance transforms and dimensions.
Missing/failed/fallback/invalid sidecar/corrupt GLB and thin native geometry preserve every requested ID and honest status.
minimal_acceptance_plan.pass: All IDs exactly once; finite positive extents; corner error<=1e-6m; merged parent graph acyclic; metadata and rendered shell agree; failures visible in counts.

minimal_acceptance_plan.name: Evaluate layouts before and after decoding
checks: Score raw argmax, attachment-only, legal-only and iterative/remask variants with matched settings; include E cache online/replay equality.
Retain every input request in success/latency denominators; report object budget and token failures.
Report boundary/door/window violations, collisions by pair and affected object, support type/contact evidence, NAV/ACC/OPC and functional relations as distinct proxies.
Unknown-size quality uses valid-label size/position/symmetry-aware yaw errors plus distributional/plausibility and blinded comparisons; do not demand one GT arrangement as the only correct room.
minimal_acceptance_plan.pass: All-request strict/conditional/unknown rates and per-source/density results available; no improvement attributed solely to an unlabelled post-processing step.

minimal_acceptance_plan.name: Controlled downstream mesh evaluation
checks: Use the same generation method, prompts, seeds and reusable asset identities across GT-layout/FastFill/LLM-layout arms; retain per-instance target dimensions.
Separate asset-generation ok/fallback/missing rates at unique-asset and requested-instance levels; never count placeholder-only renderability as mesh success.
Measure generated asset semantics (VQA/SigLIP) separately from actual assembled mesh containment/collision/opening clearance and support contact; include pre/post-fit scale distortion and rotations.
For support, report conditional ray-contact score plus available/required pair counts; floor/wall support, balance and dynamics require extra checks.
minimal_acceptance_plan.pass: One immutable receipt links request→prediction→asset→fitted mesh→all checks. Strict mesh-layout success requires all requested genuine meshes and declared mandatory geometric checks passing; unknown evidence remains explicit.

minimal_acceptance_plan.name: Evidence ladder and reporting
checks: Use the five official rooms as interface and illustrative transfer cases; they are too few for a generalization claim.
Expand held-out rooms by source/house, density, shell topology, openings and support complexity; resample by house when dependencies exist.
Report paired CIs and failure/coverage at each stage; distinguish transport tests from trained-model performance and physical simulation.
Freeze a failure gallery and blind room-render judgments; compare against shuffled/random/room-center and GT-layout anchors.
minimal_acceptance_plan.pass: A reader can identify whether a failure came from layout, unknown size, support prediction, asset generation, fit policy or evaluation.

executed: Read-only GitHub text fetches; CPU conversion/shell/synthetic-cuboid assembly fixtures using downloaded official pure geometry helper. No model training, asset generation, VLM/GPU scoring, external writes or submodule initialization.
scope_limits: Original full-resolution SAGE meshes/model assets/renders are not present locally, so official VLM/DINO/F-score numbers were not rerun.
Synthetic cuboid smoke tests do not establish learned-model quality or genuine generation success.
No project source changed by this agent; concurrent parent changes are outside this task.
